name: study_session
description: Student pack: runs a focused study session with timed breaks (Pomodoro style). Use when the user says 'start a study session', 'help me study X', 'pomodoro', 'study for 45 minutes'.
instructions: 1. Work out the subject and the session length from what the user said (default 25 minutes of study, 5 minute break; if they say a total time like 2 hours, plan repeated 25+5 blocks). 2. Call focus_mode with action 'on' so notifications are held while they study. 3. Call create_reminder with due_in_minutes = the study length and text like 'Break time. You studied <subject> for <n> minutes. Stand up, drink some water.' 4. For each further block in the plan, create another reminder for the end of the next break ('Back to <subject>, block 2 of 4') and for the end of that block, at the right minute offsets from now. 5. Call remember_fact with category 'fact' and a line like 'Study log <today's date>: <subject>, <total minutes> planned' so the weekly recap can count it. 6. Reply in one or two short spoken sentences: what you set up and when the first break is. If they ask to stop early, call focus_mode 'off' and cancel_reminder for the remaining session reminders (use list_reminders to find them).
